newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER CHILAVERT SCORES AGAIN FOR VELEZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER CHILAVERT SCORES AGAIN FOR VELEZ.

text.p: Irrepressible goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert scored his ninth goal this year to give Argentina's Velez Sarsfield a 2-1 win away to Santos of Brazil in a South American Supercup semi-final tie on Wednesday.

Chilavert calmly stroked home a penalty three minutes from the end of the first leg match, sending Santos goalkeeper Edinho -- Pele's son -- the wrong way and claiming his first goal on Brazilian soil.
Chilavert, a Paraguayan who also takes his team's free kicks, orchestrated Velez's performance from his goal.

He created three of their best goalscoring chances with his huge goal kicks upfield, which repeatedly caught the Santos defence off their guard, but also found time to defend his own goal, making several important saves.

Chilavert, who denied beforehand that the chance to score against Pele's son had given him extra motivation, also took two free kicks within a three-minute spell in the second half but was not on target with either.
He played the second half without his trademark goalkeeping shirt, which features a bulldog, as it was ripped in the first half and had to be traded for a bright red one at halftime.
Striker Martin Posse had put Velez ahead in the 12th minute with Alessandro equalising for Santos 10 minutes later.
Chilavert's goal was his second in the Supercup, the first coming from a free kick in a quarter-final tie against Olimpia.

Cruzeiro, another Brazilian side, played 45 minutes of exhilirating football to take a 3-1 halftime lead at home to Chile's Colo Colo but then tired and allowed the Chileans to pull a second goal back.
In the Conmebol Cup, defending champions Rosario Central of Argentina conceeded two own goals as they crashed 3-0 away to Lanus in the first leg of their semi-final.
Uruguayan Ruben da Silva mis-hit an attempted clearance straight into his own goal on the stroke of halftime and team- mate Horacio Carbonari delivered a repeat performance early in the second half.
Oscar Mena completed the scoring with a powerful drive in the 77th minute to give Rosario a difficult task in the second leg.
